WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 22 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region,
           SUM(n.net_sales) AS all_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN n.net_sales END) AS lfl_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    LEFT JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.all_sales AS ty_all, ly.all_sales AS ly_all, ROUND(100.0*(ty.all_sales/ly.all_sales-1),2) AS g_all,
       ty.lfl_sales AS ty_lfl, ly.lfl_sales AS ly_lfl, ROUND(100.0*(ty.lfl_sales/ly.lfl_sales-1),2) AS g_lfl
FROM agg ty JOIN agg ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY g_lfl DESC

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS loaded FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), NULL FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT (business_date, store_id)), NULL, MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date), NULL FROM rpt_daily_store_sales

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), m AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(v) AS mine
  FROM mine JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = mine.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = mine.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week <= 22 GROUP BY 1,2
), c AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = r.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week <= 22 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.region, m.mine, c.ctrl, m.mine - c.ctrl AS diff FROM m JOIN c USING (fiscal_year, region) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT s.store_id, s.region, d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, MIN(f.sale_date) AS mn, MAX(f.sale_date) AS mx, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l0, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l1, MAX(c) AS maxc
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 22 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
sales_dedup AS (
    -- store 116 week of 15-21 Sep 2025 was loaded twice: keep the first load of each receipt line
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region,
           SUM(n.net_sales) AS all_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN n.net_sales END) AS lfl_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    LEFT JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.lfl_sales/ly.lfl_sales DESC) AS rank, ty.region,
       ROUND(ty.lfl_sales, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.lfl_sales, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0*(ty.lfl_sales/ly.lfl_sales-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
       ROUND(ty.all_sales, 2) AS ty_all, ROUND(ly.all_sales, 2) AS ly_all, ROUND(100.0*(ty.all_sales/ly.all_sales-1),2) AS g_all
FROM agg ty JOIN agg ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY rank
